description: EPANET-RWCGGA extends the hydraulic solver with an unsteady incompressible-flow algorithm, valve-opening resistance and convergence tracking. The provider reports applications to three networks of different complexity. This resource is provided by Lew Rossman; Sam Hatchett; xuxi and coauthors. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: other-open. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The software is distinct from core EPANET but remains a research extension; numerical performance was not checked. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
